title: Pager read-only and journal-mode observations

scope.rationale: sqlite3PagerIsreadonly and sqlite3PagerGetJournalMode directly expose the pager's live read-only flag and journal mode.

external_source_responsibilities: Pager open and journal-mode mutation owners
dependencies.caller_closure: Both complete observation bodies are assigned; public PRAGMA/configuration consumers remain open.

outputs: Live read-only boolean and current JournalMode
contracts.state_and_results: Return stored fields exactly without normalization or mutation.
contracts.locks_callbacks_io: No callbacks or I/O; caller synchronization external.
contracts.failure_and_continuation: No failure paths and no state mutation.

representation_differences: JournalMode is a typed Zig enum instead of an integer result; enum members correspond to source PAGER_JOURNALMODE values.
The read-only u8 is exposed as bool.

oracle.protocol: Seed read_only true and journal_mode truncate, then observe exact values.
oracle.normalization: Source nonzero u8 maps to true; journal mode compares semantically by enum member.

integration.native_call_path: Typed accessors and direct state trace exist; public configuration consumers remain pending.

independent_review.notes: Requires open/mutation consumer integration, pinned-C trace, assurance closure, and independent review.

implementation_spans: src/core/internal/pager_core.zig read_only/journal_mode state and transitions were reviewed
callers: B-tree read-only checks and journal-mode configuration/PRAGMA paths
Unit trace invokes both accessors directly
assertions_branches_cleanup: Both sole return blocks are assigned
No branches, allocation, mutation, or cleanup
upstream_tests: Upstream read-only VFS and journal-mode tests cover these observations
